meta.title: Awesome Agentic AI Security Catalog
meta.description: Open catalog and rule-based Solution & Tool Validation Agent for AI, LLM, agentic and MCP security tools with OWASP ASI mapping, lifecycle coverage, evidence levels, risk-control-tool matrix, benchmark scaffolding, and scenario-based solution reports.

dimensions.red_team: Red teaming and adversarial evaluation depth
dimensions.runtime: Runtime enforcement, prevention or inline policy control
dimensions.data_security: PII, secrets, RAG/vector store and sensitive-data controls
dimensions.observability: Tracing, monitoring, evaluation and dashboard fit
dimensions.compliance: Evidence, governance, reporting and standard mapping
dimensions.enterprise: Enterprise readiness: RBAC, deployment, auditability, support
dimensions.self_host: Ability to run without sending data to a SaaS provider
dimensions.ease: Ease of adoption for an engineering team
dimensions.agentic_readiness: Composite readiness for autonomous agent workflows: goal integrity, tool security, identity, memory, runtime, audit, and multi-agent controls
dimensions.mcp_security: MCP server/client security coverage: inventory, third-party server risk, tool permissions, authn/authz, sanitization, audit, sandboxing, supply chain
dimensions.lifecycle_coverage: Breadth of coverage across the OWASP Agentic SecOps lifecycle stages
dimensions.supply_chain: Supply-chain, SBOM/AIBOM, dependency, model, plugin, prompt, and MCP server provenance coverage

agentic_score_dimensions.goal_integrity: Detects or constrains goal drift, prompt/tool-output goal hijack, and instruction override in multi-step workflows
agentic_score_dimensions.tool_security: Validates tool calls, function parameters, dangerous actions, and tool-output trust boundaries
agentic_score_dimensions.identity_control: Supports least privilege, delegated identity, scoped credentials, RBAC/ABAC, and approval boundaries
agentic_score_dimensions.memory_security: Protects memory, RAG context, vector stores, and long-lived state from poisoning or leakage
agentic_score_dimensions.runtime_enforcement: Can block, redact, route, rate-limit, approve, or terminate risky actions at runtime
agentic_score_dimensions.auditability: Provides traces, evidence, replayable sessions, policy decisions, and governance records
agentic_score_dimensions.multi_agent_coverage: Covers agent-to-agent handoff, delegation, inter-agent communication, and cascading workflow risk
agentic_score_dimensions.mcp_security: Covers MCP clients/servers/tools, third-party server risk, permissioning, and MCP supply-chain controls

mcp_score_dimensions.server_inventory: Discovers and inventories MCP servers, clients, tools, prompts, and exposed capabilities
mcp_score_dimensions.third_party_server_risk: Assesses external or third-party MCP server trust, provenance, and data exposure risk
mcp_score_dimensions.tool_permissioning: Constrains tool scope, parameters, actions, and approval policy at the MCP/tool boundary
mcp_score_dimensions.authn_authz: Supports authentication, authorization, scoped credentials, user-to-agent delegation, and least privilege
mcp_score_dimensions.input_output_sanitization: Scans MCP inputs, tool outputs, resources, and prompts for injection or sensitive data
mcp_score_dimensions.audit_trace: Produces policy decision logs, tool-call traces, and correlation metadata for investigations
mcp_score_dimensions.sandboxing: Isolates untrusted tools, code execution, file access, network access, or server-side actions
mcp_score_dimensions.supply_chain: Detects dependency, plugin, server package, repository, and provenance risks around MCP components

lifecycle_stage_descriptions.scope_plan: Threat model agents, non-human identities, tool scopes, delegation logic, memory isolation, and business goals before build.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.augment_finetune_data: Sanitize datasets, memory seeds, reasoning traces, RAG sources, provenance, and privacy controls.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.develop_experiment: Secure agent loops, tool wrappers, MCP contracts, plugin interfaces, and policy hooks in frameworks.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.test_evaluate: Run adversarial red-team tests, goal drift simulations, sandboxed tool-call tests, and multi-agent scenarios.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.release: Package and verify agent graphs, prompts, policies, memory snapshots, model/tool SBOMs, signatures, and trust registry entries.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.deploy: Enforce zero-trust communication, short-lived credentials, runtime guardrails, allowlists, and inter-agent authorization.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.operate: Detect runtime drift, memory mutation, task replay, hallucination loops, rogue behavior, plugin CVEs, and unsafe tool use.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.monitor: Correlate agent-step telemetry, tool calls, inter-agent messages, immutable logs, anomalies, and audit evidence.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.govern: Maintain agent registries, access reviews, lifecycle rotation, compliance evidence, alignment audits, and policy baselines.

meta.lifecycle_formula: lifecycle_coverage = min(5, count(lifecycle_stages) / 9 * 5) with extra manual adjustment allowed for stage depth.

release_notes.v0.9: Adds a deterministic Solution & Tool Validation Agent with scenario parsing, ASI risk mapping, tool recommendation, evidence checks, benchmark planning, and sample solution reports.
